## Graph rules

### `tool_req__docs_arch_link_qm_to_safety_req`
Applies to: `comp_arc_sta`, `feat_arc_sta`, `logic_arc_int`, `logic_arc_int_op`, `real_arc_int`, `real_arc_int_op`

Condition:
```text
safety == QM
```

Check (`check_all`: every linked need must satisfy its condition):
```text
{
  "fulfils": "safety != QM"
}
```

Explanation: An QM architecture element cannot implement ASIL requirements.

### `tool_req__docs_arch_link_safety_to_req`
Applies to: `comp`, `comp_arc_dyn`, `comp_arc_sta`, `feat_arc_dyn`, `feat_arc_sta`, `logic_arc_int`, `real_arc_int`

Condition:
```text
safety != QM
```

Check (`check_one`: at least one linked need must satisfy its condition):
```text
{
  "fulfils": "safety == self.safety"
}
```

Explanation: A safety relevant architecture element must be linked to at least one requirement with the exact same safety value via fulfils.

### `tool_req__docs_arch_link_security`
Applies to: `comp_arc_sta`, `feat_arc_sta`, `logic_arc_int`, `logic_arc_int_op`, `real_arc_int`, `real_arc_int_op`

Condition:
```text
security == YES
```

Check (`check_all`: every linked need must satisfy its condition):
```text
{
  "implements": "security == YES"
}
```

Explanation: An security architecture element can only link other security architecture elements.

### `tool_req__docs_common_attr_safety_link_check`
Applies to: `aou_req`, `comp_req`, `feat_req`, `gd_req`, `stkh_req`, `tool_req`

Condition:
```text
safety == QM
```

Check (`check_all`: every linked need must satisfy its condition):
```text
{
  "derived_from": "safety == QM"
}
```

Explanation: QM requirements cannot be derived from ASIL requirements.

### `tool_req__docs_req_arch_link_safety_to_arch`
Applies to: `comp`, `comp_arc_sta`, `feat`, `feat_arc_sta`, `logic_arc_int`, `logic_arc_int_op`, `real_arc_int`, `real_arc_int_op`

Condition:
```text
{
  "and": [
    "safety != QM",
    {
      "or": [
        "status == valid",
        "status == valid_inspected"
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

Check (`check_all`: every linked need must satisfy its condition):
```text
{
  "implements": {
    "and": [
      "safety != QM",
      {
        "or": [
          "status == valid",
          "status == valid_inspected"
        ]
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

Explanation: An safety architecture element can only link other safety architecture elements.

### `tool_req__docs_saf_attrs_mitigated_by`
Applies to: `comp_saf_dfa`, `comp_saf_fmea`, `feat_saf_dfa`, `feat_saf_fmea`

Condition:
```text
status == valid
```

Check (`check_one`: at least one linked need must satisfy its condition):
```text
{
  "mitigated_by": {
    "or": [
      "safety == ASIL_B",
      "type == aou_req"
    ]
  }
}
```

Explanation: Valid safety analyses should link to at least one same-level or higher-safety requirement, or an Assumption of Use requirement.

### `workproduct_aspice_40`
Applies to: `workproduct`

Condition:
```text
complies != []
```

Check (`check_all`: every linked need must satisfy its condition):
```text
{
  "complies": {
    "or": [
      "id contains aspice_40__iic",
      "id contains std_wp"
    ]
  }
}
```

Explanation: Workproducts may only link to ASPICE 40 IIC stakeholder requirements. Please ensure that the linked requirement is an ASPICE 40 IIC stakeholder requirement.

## Prohibited words

- `content_check` checks `content` for `requirement_excl_process`: `about`, `absolutely`, `just`, `really`, `some`, `thing`.
- `title_check` checks `title` for all tags: `must`, `shall`, `will`.
